sub_strands.name: Whole Numbers up to 100,000
performance_indicators: Read, write, and determine the place value of digits in numbers up to 100,000.
Round off whole numbers to the nearest thousands.
Find the Least Common Multiple (LCM) and Greatest Common Divisor (GCD) of up to three numbers.

sub_strands.name: Fractions, Decimals, and Percentages
performance_indicators: Add and subtract mixed numbers with different denominators.
Convert simple fractions into decimals and percentages and vice versa using visual grids.
Multiply a decimal number by a whole number up to two decimal places.

sub_strands.name: Area, Perimeter, and Volume
performance_indicators: Calculate the perimeter and area of combined regular shapes (rectangles and squares).
Determine the volume of cubes and cuboids using standard cubic centimeters (cm³).
Convert capacity measurements between liters (l) and milliliters (ml).

sub_strands.name: Angles, Circles, and Expressions
performance_indicators: Measure and draw angles up to 180 degrees using a protractor.
Identify parts of a circle including the radius, diameter, and circumference.
Formulate and solve simple linear equations with one unknown variable.

sub_strands.name: Oral Reports and Public Speaking
performance_indicators: Listen to audio presentations and summarize key data points and supporting arguments.
Deliver short, structured oral presentations using appropriate tone, intonation, and body language.

sub_strands.name: Critical Literacy and Literary Texts
performance_indicators: Read complex informational texts fluently, adjusting reading speed based on difficulty.
Analyze short stories and poems to identify themes, imagery, and figurative language.
Make logical inferences and draw conclusions based on text clues.

sub_strands.name: Advanced Grammar and Composition
performance_indicators: Use active and passive voice correctly in context-specific sentences.
Write functional pieces, including simple formal invitations, recipes, and diary entries.
Draft narrative and descriptive essays with well-structured introduction, body, and conclusion paragraphs.

sub_strands.name: Uwasilishaji na Majadiliano
performance_indicators: Kusikiliza hotuba fupi au matangazo na kutoa muhtasari wa hoja kuu.
Kushiriki katika mdahalo wa darasani kwa kutumia lugha sanifu na hoja zenye mashiko.

sub_strands.name: Uchambuzi wa Makala na Fasihi
performance_indicators: Kusoma vifungu vya habari kwa sauti na kwa kimya huku ukizingatia alama zote za uandishi.
Kueleza maadili na mafunzo mbalimbali yanayopatikana katika hadithi za kimapokeo au mashairi mepesi.

sub_strands.name: Uandishi wa Insha na Matumizi ya Lugha
performance_indicators: Kuandika insha za maelezo na barua rasmi (kwa mfano, barua ya udhuru) kwa kufuata utaratibu ufaao.
Kutumia viunganishi, viashiria, na ngeli changamano kwa usahihi katika aya.

sub_strands.name: Human Respiratory System and Vertebrates
performance_indicators: Identify the organs of the human respiratory system and model their function using local materials.
Classify animals into vertebrates (mammals, birds, reptiles, amphibians, fish) based on physical features.
Describe methods of maintaining health and preventing infections within the respiratory system.

sub_strands.name: Changes in States of Matter and Light Energy
performance_indicators: Demonstrate melting, evaporation, condensation, and freezing through simple heat experiments.
Investigate how light travels in a straight line and its reflection on different surfaces.

sub_strands.name: Word Processing and Data Handling
performance_indicators: Create, edit, and format text documents using a word processing application on a digital device.
Demonstrate safe behavior and digital citizenship when interacting with electronic learning devices.

sub_strands.name: Organic Manures and Fruit Trees
performance_indicators: Prepare compost or heap manure using organic farm wastes and apply it to improve soil fertility.
Demonstrate the steps of establishing and caring for local fruit tree nurseries (e.g., passion fruit, pawpaw).
Identify and control common field pests and weeds using safe, non-chemical methods.

sub_strands.name: Rabbits and Small Herbivores
performance_indicators: Describe the housing, feeding, and handling requirements for domestic rabbits or small livestock.
Identify common signs of ill health in farm animals and describe basic response steps.

sub_strands.name: Deficiency Diseases and Food Preservation
performance_indicators: Identify common nutritional deficiency diseases (e.g., marasmus, kwashiorkor) and list preventive foods.
Demonstrate practical methods of preserving local food items through drying, salting, or smoking.

sub_strands.name: Position, Size, and Physical Features of Kenya
performance_indicators: Locate Kenya on a map of East Africa and identify its neighboring countries.
Describe the main physical features of Kenya (mountains, rivers, lakes, rift valley) and their impact on human settlement.
Read and interpret map symbols using standard keys and scale indicators.

sub_strands.name: Migration and Cultural Heritage
performance_indicators: Trace the migration patterns and settlement of major language groups in Kenya.
Discuss traditional cultural practices, beliefs, and values that promote national cohesion.
Identify key early historical figures and freedom fighters who contributed to Kenyan history.

sub_strands.name: Economic Sectors and National Governance
performance_indicators: Analyze major economic activities in Kenya, including agriculture, mining, and tourism.
Explain the structure and main arms of the national government of Kenya (Legislature, Executive, Judiciary).

sub_strands.name: Pictorial Composition and Puppetry
performance_indicators: Paint compositions showing tonal variations and spatial perspective.
Construct different types of puppets (e.g., glove or rod puppets) using local fabrics and sticks.
Create functional ornaments using beadwork or leatherwork techniques.

sub_strands.name: Choral Performance and Play Writing
performance_indicators: Sing in multi-part harmony during group choral presentations with accurate rhythm.
Create and act out brief dramatic scripts focusing on contemporary social issues (e.g., environmental conservation).

sub_strands.name: Gymnastics and Ball Games
performance_indicators: Perform advanced gymnastic sequences involving handstands or cartwheels safely.
Demonstrate technical skills like passing, dribbling, and shooting in field games (football, netball, or volleyball).

sub_strands.name: Christian Values and Ministries
performance_indicators: Examine lessons on faith and endurance from the lives of biblical characters like Abraham and Elijah.
Explain the roles of early Christian prophets and apply their ethical teachings to current social situations.
Demonstrate Christian values including integrity, fairness, and inclusion in school interactions.

sub_strands.name: Surahs, Hadith, and Islamic History
performance_indicators: Recite, memorize, and explain the core meanings of Surah Al-Fil and Surah Al-Humazah.
Describe the historical events surrounding the Hijrah (migration) of the Prophet to Madinah.
Apply Islamic moral codes regarding honesty in business transactions and peer interactions.

sub_strands.name: Character Solidification and Integrity
performance_indicators: Demonstrate self-reliance and moral courage when encountering negative peer influences.
Practice collaborative conflict resolution to maintain harmony in the classroom environment.
Apply ethical principles to daily choices through structured values mentorship.
